name: Canonizer
tagline: Keeps one running status file that carries work between sessions
description: Work spread across chat threads, a local agent and a file store loses its thread the moment you stop. This pulls together where each piece was left and what came out of it into a single running document, consulted at the top of a session and written back to whenever you set something down.
author: hudcos
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
